name: Holiday
overview: The Bible teaches that God instituted a sacred rhythm of rest for the land every seventh year, known as the sabbath of the land, as described in Leviticus 25:2-7. During this year, the Israelites were commanded not to sow their fields or prune their vineyards, allowing the land to rest and produce food naturally for all, including servants, strangers, and animals. This practice underscores God's provision and the importance of trust in His care while honoring His command to observe regular periods of rest.
